2607.06157.title: LLM Agents for Deliberative Collaboration: A Study on Joint Decision Making Under Partial Observability
2607.06157.paper_summary: Deliberation plays a crucial role in collaboration; when humans work together, they naturally engage in communication to align information and reach an agreement. In this paper, we investigate deliberative large language model (LLM) agents under partially observable joint decision-making tasks. We formalize deliberative collaboration as a cooperative joint decision problem with partial and asymmetric observations, and introduce a scalable benchmark that instantiates this problem across multiple task settings and domains in which agents must exchange information through deliberation to reach a joint decision with a shared reward. We then instantiate a reference scaffold and evaluation protocol for deliberative agents and conduct a systematic evaluation of a range of representative LLMs. The results reveal that complex deliberative collaboration tasks continue to challenge state-of-the-art language models. Even with the aid of external mathematical tools, language models may fail in either the deliberation process for aligning information or the complex reasoning process for making the decision. On the other hand, diagnostic analysis reveals that the deliberation process may also provide opportunities for reflection and error correction, sometimes improving performance over centralized baselines. Altogether, our work establishes a foundation for evaluating and improving LLM agents in deliberative collaboration and provides insights into the strengths, limitations, and properties of current LLM-based multi-agent systems.
2607.06157.paper_summary_zh: 深思熟慮在協作中扮演著至關重要的角色；當人類共同工作時，他們自然會進行交流，以對齊信息並達成共識。<lb/>在本文中，我們研究了在部分可觀察的聯合決策任務下的深思熟慮大型語言模型（LLM）代理。<lb/>我們將深思熟慮的協作形式化為一個具有部分和不對稱觀察的合作聯合決策問題，並引入一個可擴展的基準，該基準在多個任務設置和領域中實現了這一問題，其中代理必須通過深思熟慮來交換信息，以達成共享獎勵的聯合決策。<lb/>然後，我們為深思熟慮的代理實例化了一個參考框架和評估協議，並對一系列代表性的LLM進行系統評估。<lb/>結果顯示，複雜的深思熟慮協作任務仍然對最先進的語言模型構成挑戰。<lb/>即使在外部數學工具的幫助下，語言模型也可能在對齊信息的深思熟慮過程或進行決策的複雜推理過程中失敗。<lb/>另一方面，診斷分析顯示，深思熟慮過程也可能提供反思和錯誤修正的機會，有時能改善相對於集中基準的表現。<lb/>總之，我們的工作為評估和改善深思熟慮協作中的LLM代理奠定了基礎，並提供了對當前基於LLM的多代理系統的優勢、局限性和特性的見解。
